description: MOCKUP OF THE NOSE SECTION of the RT-23UTTKh (RS-22; NATO SS-24 Scalpel) rail and silo based intercontinental ballistic missile; stands beside the preserved silo. The museum's whole reason for existing is that the last SS-24 silo here was destroyed on 30 October 2001 and this launch position was kept intact instead. The silo itself — 35 m deep with a 121-tonne protective cover — is the principal exhibit and is not an airframe record
